title: Management of moderate to severe monotraumatic pain with sublingual Sufentanil in an emergency situation.
official: SubSUF-ER - Management of moderate to severe monotraumatic pain with sublingual Sufentanil in an emergency situation.
summary: Main objective: to determine the efficacy of the use of sublingual sufentanil 30mcg in emergency patients admitted for moderate to severe pain following a single trauma compared to the standard management currently in the department between T0 and T0 + 60 min.
conditions: trauma to the lower or upper limb

interventions.name: KALINOX 50 %/ 50 % Gas zur medizinischen Anwendung, druckverdichtet
TRAMADOL ARROW 100 mg/2 mL, solution injectable/pour perfusion
KETOPROFENE AGUETTANT 100 mg, solution pour perfusion
PARACETAMOL AGUETTANT 10 mg/ml, solution pour perfusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. adult patient
2. Patient with a numeric pain rating scale  ≥ 4
3. Pain of monotraumatic origin in the upper or lower limb
4. Glasgow = 15
5. SaO2 > 95% in ambient air
Exclusion criteria:
1. Polytrauma
2. Patient under guardianship, curatorship, deprived of liberty or under legal protection
3. Patient does not speak or read French
4. Analgesic treatment within 4 hours prior to admission (except paracetamol)
5. Woman of childbearing age not using effective contraception, or declaring herself pregnant or at risk of pregnancy or breastfeeding woman, or positive pregnancy test upon inclusion
6. Patient requiring intravenous line placement upon admission
7. Contraindication or allergy to one of the molecules in the analgesic protocol
8. Refusal to participate
9. Known drug abuse or psychiatric disorders
10. Known oxygen dependency or COPD
11. Not affiliated with social security

sites.f: University Hospital Of Clermont-Ferrand – SAMU - SMUR Urgences
